user.title: Connect to your Xiaomi rice cooker
user.description: Enter the cooker's IP address. Leave the token empty to import it from another Xiaomi integration using the same IP, or paste it manually. Leave model empty to auto-detect it. Known models: {known_models}

data.token: miIO token (optional, auto-imported when left empty)
data.name: Name

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the IP, token, and that the cooker is on the same network. If auto-detection fails, fill in the model field.
error.token_not_found: No saved miIO token was found for that IP. Add the cooker to Xiaomi Miio/Xiaomi Miot Auto first, or paste its token manually.

data.profiles: Custom profiles (JSON list of title/profile objects)
